card.name: Inside corticosteroid and similar long words
card.fires_on: The middle piece "ic" in the split word cort-ic-osteroids, mostly in drug-label warnings about topical or systemic corticosteroids. It also fires on the middle piece of a few other long words, such as tach-yc-ardia and deflaz-ac-ort.
